question: Does one bounded source-independent cross-component residual-correlation matrix transfer to wholly new archival-film sources and materially outperform independent colour-layer grain?

primary_basis.title: Recommendation ITU-T H.274 (V4)
primary_basis.relevance: The current standard explicitly permits component-dependent film-grain models and cross-component contribution; this experiment tests only the missing cross-component observable, not wire conformance.

primary_basis.title: FGA-NN: Film Grain Analysis Neural Network
primary_basis.relevance: The latest analysis paper predicts conventional intensity- and component-specific synthesis parameters; no paper code, model or data is consumed here.

development.role: fit one shared cross-component correlation matrix; no source identity enters the fit

confirmation.selection_rule: Sort eligible first clips with exactly ten PNG frames and select indices 28 and 29; confirmation pixels remain unread until the matrix and all gates freeze.

decode.interpretation: encoded archival RGB code values divided by 255; not scene-linear exposure, dye density or scanner-independent colour

patch_observation.selection_score: lowest RMS gradient of low-pass luminance with y/x tie break
patch_observation.residual: each RGB code channel minus its reflect-mode Gaussian low-pass
patch_observation.normalization: per patch and channel subtract mean and divide by population RMS; reject RMS below 1e-6

candidate.fit: equal-patch mean of each normalized residual outer product, symmetrize, force exact unit diagonal, then require the unfixed matrix itself to be positive definite and inside the frozen envelope
candidate.candidate_control: cyclic channel permutation of the frozen fitted matrix

metrics.per_source_observation: mean of per-patch 3x3 residual correlation matrices

branch_rule.pass: Retain one bounded generic cross-component grain correlation as an archival scanner-convolved mechanism and open only an exact-spectrum synthesis control; no photographic or product integration.
branch_rule.fail: Retain independent colour layers and close this exact shared-matrix family without shrinkage, channel remapping, source routing or threshold rescue.

forbidden: read confirmation pixels before the shared matrix, controls, metrics and gates freeze
fit per-source, per-frame, per-patch, stock-specific or scanner-specific matrices
clip, shrink, eigencorrect or otherwise repair a failed fitted matrix
change the channel order, low-pass, split, source set, metric or gate after confirmation
claim physical dye-layer coupling, stock/process/scanner calibration, visual safety or product readiness
claim_ceiling: Two-source held-out archival RGB-code evidence for one generic cross-component residual correlation; scanner, restoration, compression and content remain mixed.
